credentials.name: classic
credentials.description: A thank-you to one AID (schema 1.0.0), not yet sealed: valid by the issuer's current key.

credentials.name: condition-group
credentials.description: A thank-you to a condition (schema 2.0.0): any of two AIDs.

credentials.name: condition-claim
credentials.description: A letter to an e-mail address: the condition is one claim key.

credentials.name: condition-unknown-kind
credentials.description: A condition with a leaf of a kind this version does not know; the credential is still valid.

credentials.name: condition-malformed
credentials.description: A condition that does not parse: the credential verifies, but nobody can ever hold it (see presentations).

credentials.name: attachment
credentials.description: A thank-you naming an attached file by its BLAKE3 digest.

credentials.name: tampered-message
credentials.description: The message was changed after signing.

credentials.name: tampered-recipient
credentials.description: The recipient AID was swapped for another.

credentials.name: tampered-version
credentials.description: The size in the version string is wrong.

credentials.name: non-canonical
credentials.description: Same content, but not in the canonical serialization (whitespace).

credentials.name: non-canonical-order
credentials.description: Same content, fields in another order.

credentials.name: non-canonical-escapes
credentials.description: Same content, non-ASCII text escaped as \uXXXX.

credentials.name: schema-mismatch
credentials.description: Recipient in a.i under the condition schema 2.0.0.

credentials.name: schema-unknown
credentials.description: A schema SAID this version does not know.

credentials.name: unknown-attribute
credentials.description: An attribute not in the schema (a.mood), with SAIDs recomputed.

credentials.name: no-signature
credentials.description: The signature group is missing.

credentials.name: forged-signature
credentials.description: Signed by another identifier's key, claiming to be the issuer.

credentials.name: kel-bad-signature
credentials.description: The issuer's inception event carries a broken signature.

credentials.name: kel-of-someone-else
credentials.description: The bundle carries another identifier's KEL.

credentials.name: stale-kel-offline
credentials.description: Signed by the issuer's key at issuance; the bundle carries only that KEL. Offline this verifies (the verifier does not know about the later rotation).

credentials.name: rotated-unsealed
credentials.description: Same thank-you, checked against the issuer's fresh KEL: it was never sealed and the key rotated, so it is void.

credentials.name: rotated-sealed
credentials.description: Sealed in a period before the rotation: valid with the fresh KEL and its period seal.

credentials.name: rotated-sealed-second-leaf
credentials.description: The other thank-you of the same period.

credentials.name: rotated-no-seal
credentials.description: Sealed, but the holder did not supply the seal: it counts as unsealed.

credentials.name: seal-of-another
credentials.description: The period seal of a different thank-you.

credentials.name: seal-not-anchored
credentials.description: A close record that the issuer never anchored.

credentials.name: anchored
credentials.description: An older thank-you anchored on its own (an event seal naming its SAID); still valid after rotation.

credentials.name: redeemed
credentials.description: Valid, and redeemed by the issuer (a digest seal of the redemption record).

credentials.name: abandoned-issuer
credentials.description: The issuer abandoned its identifier (rotation to no next key); unsealed thanks are void.

archives.name: legacy-signatures-json
archives.description: Written by DzenQ before dzq/1.0: an empty signatures.json, ignored.

archives.name: lying-metadata
archives.description: metadata.json disagrees with the credential; metadata is never trusted.

archives.name: attachment
archives.description: With the attached file the credential names.

archives.name: attachment-swapped
archives.description: The attached file was replaced; the credential is valid, the file is not its.

archives.name: attachment-missing
archives.description: The credential names a file the archive lacks.

archives.name: path-traversal
archives.description: An entry that escapes the archive.

archives.name: unexpected-entry
archives.description: An entry dzq/1.0 does not define.

archives.name: not-zip
archives.description: Not a ZIP file at all.

presentations.name: classic
presentations.description: Bob proves he holds a thank-you addressed to him.

presentations.name: wrong-nonce
presentations.description: The same proof, made for another request.

presentations.name: display-only
presentations.description: No verifier code was asked for: shown, but proves no freshness.

presentations.name: not-the-recipient
presentations.description: Carol presents Bob's thank-you as hers.

presentations.name: group-member
presentations.description: Carol holds the group thank-you (any of Bob, Carol).

presentations.name: letter-claimed
presentations.description: Dave got the letter key through his e-mail and claims the letter.

presentations.name: letter-no-claim
presentations.description: Dave presents the letter without the claim.

presentations.name: letter-claim-for-another
presentations.description: Dave presents a claim made out to another AID.

presentations.name: letter-claim-bad-signature
presentations.description: The claim signature does not verify.

presentations.name: all-of-two-claims
presentations.description: all(…) of two claim keys, both claimed.

presentations.name: all-of-two-claims-one-missing
presentations.description: all(…) with only one of the two claims.

presentations.name: unknown-kind-other-leaf
presentations.description: Bob meets any(txn:…, Bob) through his AID; the unknown leaf is never met.

presentations.name: malformed-condition
presentations.description: Nobody holds a thank-you whose condition does not parse.

presentations.name: tampered-payload
presentations.description: The payload was edited after the holder signed it.

presentations.name: sealed-after-rotation
presentations.description: Bob presents a sealed thank-you whose issuer rotated since; the bundle carries the fresh KEL and the presentation the seal.

presentations.name: unsealed-after-rotation
presentations.description: The same issuer's unsealed thank-you, with the fresh KEL: void.
